guidelines.detail: documentation rule EVT-03 not applied (The description presents the restart as something that occurs before measuring continues, while the generated model labels it as a task (P1, S3). That supports modeling the trigger as a catch event. The documented guideline EVT-03 already says to use an intermediate catch event when flow waits for a trigger.)

refines EVT-03 (The description says measuring continues when the machine is restarted, and the records show missing flows around the restart wait and continuation. This refines EVT-03 by specifying how to connect the catch event to resumed work.)

same as LRN-084 (The description says measuring continues after the machine is restarted (S3), but the generated wait element has no counterpart for the activity that resumes afterward (M4); P1 also records that the restart wait was modeled as a receive task. This supports modeling the trigger separately from the resumed activity, matching learned guideline LRN-084.)

same as LRN-084 (The description says measurement continues when the machine is restarted, while the records show the expected continuation flow is absent. LRN-084 already gives the same guidance. Modeling the wait as a catch event follows BPMN semantics rather than copying the reference model’s receiveTask choice.)

documentation rule EVT-03 not applied (The description says measuring continues when the machine has been restarted, while the generated model represents waiting for that restart as a manual task (P1, S3). This supports modeling the wait as a catch event. Documented guideline EVT-03 already says to use an intermediate catch event when flow waits for a trigger.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that multiple distinct pieces of information are collected and are all needed for a later calculation: Model the information-collection work as parallel branches and synchronize those branches before the calculation that depends on all of them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that multiple distinct pieces of information are collected and are all needed for a later calculation

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use an intermediate catch event when flow waits for a trigger and an intermediate throw event when flow emits or raises a result.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that the process continues or resumes when an occurrence happens, without describing the process performing that occurrence

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says ongoing work should resume when an external trigger occurs: Model the wait for that trigger with an intermediate catch event, and connect it to the activity that resumes the work.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says ongoing work should resume when an external trigger occurs
